name: Ha'il

queries.query: Saudi Arabia official cadastral map parcel viewer Ha'il municipality GIS parcels
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the General Authority for Real Estate Geospatial Real Estate Portal, the National Geospatial Platform, and Balady urban/municipal map services. The results describe land-parcel/map coverage at national or service level but did not expose a Ha'il-specific anonymous parcel API or downloadable parcel geometry.

queries.query: السعودية حائل خريطة كادستر قطع الأراضي منصة رسمية
queries.result: أظهرت النتائج بوابة العقار الجيومكانية التابعة للهيئة العامة للعقار، والمنصة الجيومكانية الوطنية، وخدمات بلدي للخرائط الحضرية وقطع الأراضي. الوصف الرسمي عام/وطني ولم يُظهر نقطة وصول عامة مجهولة لقطع أراضي حائل أو استجابة هندسية قابلة للفحص.

registryEvidence.officialNationalCustodian: General Authority for Real Estate (REGA) and General Authority for Survey and Geospatial Information (GEOSA) national geospatial/real-estate portals
registryEvidence.assessment: Official sources evidence national real-estate/geospatial map services and a land-parcels category, but no Ha'il municipal/local cadastral custodian, public layer endpoint, or city-specific coverage was independently established. registryFound remains null rather than false.

attemptedRoutes.route: REGA Geospatial Real Estate Portal description
attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200/search content retrieved. It describes interactive spatial/descriptive real-estate maps including cities, neighborhoods, land parcels, and spatial search. No public service URL, field schema, CRS, native parcel identity, or Ha'il geometry was exposed in the page content.

TLS-verified HTTP 200. Current HTML loads /Geoportal/static/js/main.c4b26dc9.js. Inspection of that current bundle confirms a Land Parcels catalog link to GeoNetwork, but no parcel request endpoint or bounded parcel response was exposed.

attemptedRoutes.route: National Geoportal Land Parcels catalog search
attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 catalog HTML retrieved. The catalog route is a search UI; direct guessed API paths returned service-not-found/404 responses. No record describing a Ha'il parcel layer, service URL, schema, CRS, or geometry was obtained.

HTTP 200/search content retrieved. It identifies the official national map as an administrative-boundary reference available through geoportal.sa, not a city parcel layer; no Ha'il parcel data was exposed.

HTTP 200 redirected to an official PDF guide. It documents an authenticated/procedural approved-land-plan service; no anonymous Ha'il parcel API or geometry was exposed and no application was submitted.

attemptedRoutes.route: Ministry of Municipalities and Housing e-services
attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200. General service directory content retrieved, including land-related services. No public Ha'il cadastral layer, native ID schema, CRS, or parcel geometry was exposed.
